title: 第一卷 第15章 敢抵抗就强制执行-《我养的AI竟是京圈太子爷》
content:
第(1/3)页

    霖多多的反应完全出乎他的预料。他本来就是想听对方说句“别怕，我就在帐篷里”，或者“怕了喊我”这样的安抚之话，没想到霖多多竟直接邀请他进帐篷。

    “不用了。”他连忙拒绝，尤其看到对方脱得只剩吊带后，声音都紧了几分，“我逗你的。我不害怕！”

    “你不用不好意思承认。”霖多多一脸“我懂你”的表情，“我小时候胆子也小的，怕黑，怕一个人睡，都是跟我姥姥挤一张床。”

    上官程小时候确实也怕这些——黑暗、孤独、一个人待在空荡荡的大房子里。但那是很久很久以前的事了。他已经长大了，而且如今还是个快穿大佬，那些恐惧他早已克服，甚至都忘记了。

    “我真的不怕！”他难得地有些急了，竖起三根手指，“我发誓！我不怕！我不能跟你睡一起——男女有别，授受不亲。”

    “嗐——”霖多多摆了摆手，语气随意，“谁把你当男人了？顶多就是个小弟弟吧！”

    得知自家AI机器人觉醒了人格意识后，霖多多对上官程的态度虽然有了转变，却并未把他当做成年男人。

    在她看来，上官程虽然有着成年人类的外观，但出厂才三年，实际只是个乳臭未干的小崽子。且对方有时带着点温和的人情味，有时又机械教条，不谙人事。如此情况，霖多多实在无法将其当做成熟的人类。

    所以在霖多多心里，他更像是个需要多加呵护、引导、教育的小弟弟。

    甚至连弟弟都不是。

    霖多多觉得，上官程害羞、敏感、干活精致又胆小，倒更像是个小女生。

    她继续朝上官程招手：“姐弟之间，或者姐妹之间，不用讲究那么多的哈。”

    “弟弟？！”

    上官程眼中的惊诧不减反增。

    霖多多十九，他二十五。若是算上前世的年龄，他已经二十八了，比霖多多大了九岁！

    她竟然把他当弟弟？

    快穿局长都不敢这么放肆！

    他深吸一口气，颇有些咬牙切齿：“那也不行。”

    “还不行？”霖多多歪头看他，目光里带了一丝探究，“难道你怕我对你做什么？”

    她想起上官程之前说过的那些“遭遇”，于是举起右手，表情认真得像在法庭上宣誓：“我发誓，绝不会对你做任何出格的事。否则就天打”

    “我相信你不会。”上官程制止了霖多多的誓言，语气有些无奈，“但我真的不怕。”

    “啧。”

    霖多多觉得这小孩子就是嘴硬——明明怕得要死，却不好意思承认。她索性下了命令：“329，进来跟我一起睡。”

Lin Duoduo’s reaction was completely beyond his expectation.He originally wanted to hear comforting words like "Don't be afraid, I'm in the tent" or "Call me if you're afraid", but he didn't expect Lin Duoduo to directly invite him into the tent.

"No need." He refused quickly, especially when he saw the other party taking off only the suspender belt, his voice became tighter, "I'm just teasing you. I'm not afraid!"

"You don't have to be embarrassed to admit it." Lin Duoduo said with an "I understand you" expression on his face, "I was timid when I was a child. I was afraid of the dark and sleeping alone, so I always shared a bed with my grandma."

Shangguan Cheng was indeed afraid of these things when he was a child - darkness, loneliness, and being alone in a big empty house.But that was a long, long time ago.He has grown up and is now a fast traveler. He has long overcome those fears and even forgotten them.

"I'm really not afraid!" He was a little anxious in a rare moment, and raised three fingers, "I swear! I'm not afraid! I can't sleep with you - there are differences between men and women, and we can't kiss each other."

"Hey -" Lin Duoduo waved his hand and said in a casual tone, "Who treats you as a man? At most, you are just a little brother!"

After learning that his AI robot had awakened its personality consciousness, Lin Duoduo’s attitude toward Shangguan Cheng changed, but he did not treat him as an adult man.

In her opinion, although Shangguan Cheng has the appearance of an adult human being, he has only been out of the factory for three years and is actually just a young cub.And sometimes the other party has a gentle human touch, and sometimes he is mechanical and dogmatic and ignorant of human affairs.Under such circumstances, Lin Duoduo really couldn't regard him as a mature human being.

So in Lin Duoduo’s heart, he is more like a little brother who needs more care, guidance and education.

Not even a younger brother.

Lin Duoduo feels that Shangguan Cheng is shy, sensitive, delicate and timid, more like a little girl.

She continued to wave to Shangguan Cheng: "Between siblings, or between sisters, there is no need to pay so much attention."

"Brother?!"

The surprise in Shangguan Cheng's eyes did not decrease but increased.

Lin Duoduo is nineteen and he is twenty-five.If the age in his previous life is included, he is already twenty-eight, nine years older than Lin Duo!

She actually regards him as her younger brother?

Director Kuai Chuan wouldn’t even dare to be so presumptuous!

He took a deep breath and gritted his teeth: "That won't work either."

"Not yet?" Lin Duoduo tilted her head and looked at him, with a hint of inquiry in her eyes, "Are you afraid of what I will do to you?"

She remembered the "experiences" that Shangguan Cheng had mentioned before, so she raised her right hand with a serious expression as if she was swearing in a court: "I swear, I will never do anything extraordinary to you. Otherwise, I will beat you."

"I believe you won't." Shangguan Cheng stopped Lin Duoduo from swearing, and said in a helpless tone, "But I'm really not afraid."

"Tsk."

Lin Duoduo felt that this kid was just being stubborn - he was obviously scared to death, but he was too embarrassed to admit it.She simply gave the order: "329, come in and sleep with me."
